response.sql:
WITH projects_with_qc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.arcregistry, p.fundflux
    FROM scanqc AS q
    JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref
), counts AS (
    SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) AS project_count
    FROM projects_with_qc
    GROUP BY fundflux
)
SELECT
    fundflux,
    project_count,
    project_count::numeric / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
    project_count::numeric / AVG(project_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average
FROM counts;

assumptions.assumption: A missing fundflux (NULL) is grouped together as its own funding-source group; the total and average are across the resulting groups.
